Priya (partnerships): Quick win update 1: Luminate Grid closed today for an AWS Marketplace listing + 18-month Dedicated commitment. Signed by Friday EOD. Huge for smart grid pilots. :tada:
Ethan (sales): Nice! Do we have the committed ARR / contract tier? Need to flag for finance.
Priya (partnerships): Committed $520k ARR, Dedicated tier: platinum (8x A100 equiv reserved), start 2026-07-01. Marketplace SKU goes live next Tuesday.
Riley (marketing): Ooh can we get a short customer quote and a one-liner about latency/cost wins? Want a short case blurb for newsletter.
Jordan (cs): Onboarding plan ready. We'll run a 2-week ramp: week 1 private control plane + edge translators, week 2 migrate forecasting jobs to Dedicated. Will share runbook.
Nina (eng): Perf notes: during PoC we hit p50=18ms p95=95ms on forecast-v3 with prefix caching enabled. Cost per 1M tokens down ~40% vs their prior self-hosted infra. We should ensure these numbers are cleared by the customer before publishing.
Ethan (sales): I'll ask for approval on the metrics and a 1-2 sentence quote. Also confirm whether they want logo in partner gallery.
provision-bot: Marketplace SKU scheduled for publish in aws-us-east-2 on 2026-05-12. Dedicated reservation created: RES-LLUM-2209 (8 nodes, us-east-2).
Priya (partnerships): Thanks team. Action items: Ethan to request quote (ETA Tue), Jordan to share onboarding runbook and access matrix, Nina to run one more capacity test with our latest quantization profile and post results. I'll draft an internal spotlight for #all-hands once we have approved quote.
Riley (marketing): I'll draft the two-sentence blurbs and a short field one-pager. Throw any headlines or numbers here and I'll iterate.
Jordan (cs): Runbook link: https://internal.gists/redwood/luminate-onboard (private)
Nina (eng): Noted 1 - scheduling load test Thu morning. Will post raw results in #eng-runtime.
Priya (partnerships): Appreciate the cross-team push on this. Luminate has strong logos in energy and utilities, should be great traction for our marketplace motion. :rocket:
